description: A wavetable oscillator whose wave is made by a small neural network from eight numbers, so the eight knobs reshape the tone rather than mixing fixed parts

params.text: Sets the pitch in whole octaves, three either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets one of the eight numbers the wave is built from, 0 to 10

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, an octave per volt, added to the OCTAVE knob and held within four octaves either side of C4
Adds to that number, one unit per volt, with the total clamped between 0 and 10

notes: the wave is built afresh only at the start of each cycle, so a change to a knob or a CV jack is heard from the next cycle onward, which is slow at low pitches and immediate at high ones.
the eight numbers have no separate meaning: they are the inputs to a decoder trained on a set of waveforms, and what each one does depends on where the other seven are set.
every knob starts at 5, the middle of its range.
